gaps.note: LuaRocks names its manifest after the package and version — `luafilesystem-1.8.0-1.rockspec` — so there is no filename to match. The registry is carried as `pkg:luarocks`; the ecosystem is not.
gaps.subject: lua

gaps.note: nimble names its manifest after the package, `<name>.nimble`. Nothing fixed to match on.
gaps.subject: nim

gaps.note: opam names its manifest after the package, `<name>.opam`, and dune-project describes a build rather than a dependency set. The registry is carried as `pkg:opam`.
gaps.subject: ocaml

gaps.note: raco reads `info.rkt`, which is also the module metadata for a collection that publishes nothing. Matching it would call every Racket collection a package.
gaps.subject: racket
